verdicts.title: Operator relaxation and the optimal depth of classical shadows
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Classical shadows are a powerful method for learning many properties of quantum states in a sample-efficient manner, by making use of randomized measurements. verdicts.title: Shadowing for differential equations with grow-up
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We consider the problem of shadowing for differential equations with grow-up. We introduce so-called nonuniform shadowing properties (in which size of the error depends on the point of the phase space) and prove for them analogs of shadowing lemma. Besides, we prove a theorem about weighted shadowing for flows.
